methods.name: private byte[] calculateCMSKeyChecksum(byte[] key)
methods.comment:
* Some key wrap algorithms make use of the Key Checksum defined
     * in CMS [CMS-Algorithms]. This is used to provide an integrity
     * check value for the key being wrapped. The algorithm is
     *
     * - Compute the 20 octet SHA-1 hash on the key being wrapped.
     * - Use the first 8 octets of this hash as the checksum value.
     *
     * For details see https://www.w3.org/TR/xmlenc-core/#sec-CMSKeyChecksum.
     *
     * @param key the key to check,
     * @return the CMS checksum.
     * @throws RuntimeException

methods.name: private boolean checkCMSKeyChecksum(byte[] key, byte[] checksum)

     * @return true if okay, false otherwise.
